title: USI Digicamp
description: Il Digicamp nasce da un'idea semplice: molte studentesse e molti studenti possiedono competenze straordinarie in diversi ambiti della digitalizzazione, acquisite durante gli studi universitari o grazie a esperienze personali ed extracurriculari. Con il Digicamp, queste competenze

blocks.html:
DigiCamp was born from a simple idea: many students possess remarkable skills in various areas of digitalization, acquired during their university studies or through personal and extracurricular experiences. With DigiCamp, these skills are given the opportunity to be showcased and shared with the university community.

USI DigiCamp 2026 will take place from 13 to 30 April 2026.

blocks.name: Peter Gruber
blocks.html: “With the USI Digicamp we showcase the wealth of capabilities of our students and recognize that teacher and student are mere roles that can be inverted.”

blocks.name: eLab - eLearning Lab
blocks.html: “The eLab promotes the DigiCamp to enhance the digital skills of the student community and to foster collaboration among students in an open and innovative learning environment”

items.title: Apply as student/teacher
items.html: Applications to enroll as a student/teacher in Digicamp 2026 are closed.

items.title: Program
items.html: The program can be found below under “Digicamp 2026.”

items.title: Registration
items.html:
Registrations are now open for the USI Digicamp, a peer-learning initiative where students can attend short, hands-on courses taught by fellow students.

The courses are open to USI Bachelor’s and Master’s students from all study fields.

You may register for as many courses as you like, provided there are no schedule overlaps.

To register, click on this link. You will be redirected to the iCorsi page. Under the “Registration” section, click on “select the course you want to attend”, then choose the course you wish to attend.

items.title: Certificate of achievement
items.html: Each participant will receive a certificate of participation provided they attend at least two of the three lessons.
